## Overview

This Adyen Docs page, captured 2026-09-15, is a **Web integration chooser** for Afterpay. It links separate method-specific Drop-in and Components guides and the main Web Sessions and Advanced integration guides. It does not itself define regional eligibility, request fields, redirect completion, capture rules or payment outcome. See [[adyen]] and [[adyen-online-payments]].

## Key takeaways

- The Drop-in link is described as an all-in-one UI option for a website. The Components link points to the method-specific Web Components guide, but its description says “Use the AfterPay” without naming a class or integration step; read the child guide for implementation detail (pinned raw lines 21–27).
- The page says to create the main integration before adding Afterpay and lists Web Drop-in and Components base guides for both Sessions and Advanced flows. These links are navigation, not proof that any particular account or regional product supports each path (lines 29–36).

## Detail locators

- Web chooser identity and method-specific child links: pinned raw lines 15–27.
- Main integration prerequisite and Sessions/Advanced base routes: lines 29–36.
